scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for every finite complete symmetric signed network; exact rational test script independently implements the source update and checks finite instances. No independent external review or comprehensive literature priority verification.
scientific_limitations: Universal all-time reception iff condition requires initially fully receptive complete symmetric signed graph and precise self-inclusive Kann--Feng update.
Finite stabilization asserted only on the strictly degree-subcritical side; no general convergence claim after loss of reception.
Step bound is finite but not asserted optimal; computational sampling is not proof of the universal theorem.
Full text of the related He--Liu--Hu--Fang 2021 signed model remained inaccessible, leaving publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp hostile-degree threshold and finite stabilization in complete signed opinion networks
